items: About Connect Bhai
What is Connect Bhai?

Connect Bhai is a broadband marketplace in Indore. You enter your PIN code, compare BSNL, Jio, Airtel and local ISP fiber, SIM, TV and OTT plans, book a connection and get the Connect Bhai Care plan after installation.
About Connect Bhai
Which is the best broadband / fiber in Indore?

It depends on your PIN code, because each area has different providers and speeds. Enter your PIN code on Connect Bhai and compare up to 3 plans side by side on speed, price, OTT and TV benefits to pick the best fit.
About Connect Bhai
What is Connect Bhai Care plan?

The Care plan lets you watch your modem through Genie, your personal assistant. You see if your router is online, check fiber signal, restart the modem, change your Wi-Fi name or password and run a line speed test from the app.
About Connect Bhai
Do I need to book a complaint if my Wi-Fi stops?

No. Open the Care plan, check whether the router is online and restart it from the app. If the line is still down, raise a complaint from your dashboard and your installer is informed. You can also call or WhatsApp us on +91 94799 35365.
About Connect Bhai
Which area does Connect Bhai serve?
Connect Bhai serves Indore, Depalpur, Mhow and Sanwer. Our office is at 215-A, Mahalaxmi Nagar, Indore (M.P.) 452010, open 08:00 to 18:00 every day.
About Connect Bhai
How do I connect with Connect Bhai?

Enter your PIN code on the home page, compare plans and request a connection. A partner calls you, and installation is done the same day. You can also call or WhatsApp +91 94799 35365, or visit our office in Mahalaxmi Nagar, Indore.
Plans
How can I compare plans by pincode?
Enter your 6-digit pincode or area on the home page. We show only the plans and TIPs that serve your address, and you can compare up to 3 plans side by side.
Plans
Are only trusted providers shown?

DSAs and BSNL TIPs) are verified by our admin team before any lead is assigned to them, and plans are reviewed before they go live. Plans marked as sample data are placeholders until verified tariffs are added.
Router & speed
Can I run a speed test before choosing?
Yes. The Wi-Fi speed test is free, takes about 30 seconds and works on your phone or laptop. Log in if you want to save the result or report slow speed to support.
Booking & payment
How do I pay the booking amount?

Requesting a connection is free for customers. When a payment is due, you get a WhatsApp message with the amount and can pay online by UPI, card or net banking. Your payments are also listed under Payments in your dashboard.
Installation
How long does installation take?

Installation is done the same day. After you request a connection, an assigned TIP calls you and books the visit. Every step (assigned, contacted, booked, installed) is updated in your dashboard, so you always see where it stands.
Router & speed
Can I check my router status after installation?

Yes, with the Connect Bhai Care plan and Genie, your personal assistant, you can see if your router is online, check fiber signal, restart it, change your Wi-Fi name or password and run a line speed test from the app.
